prompt:
Open input.docx with the current jubarte CLI at {binary}. This is a template-flow task with two desired-text rewrites in one plan. Write a JSON plan file at {output}.plan that does both rewrites in one operations array:

1. Rewrite paragraph p1 to "This is the rewritten first section. It still uses the default single-column layout.".
2. Rewrite paragraph p7 to "We have switched back to a single column layout for detailed explanations.".

The plan must declare author "{author}". Apply the plan with `jubarte edit input.docx --plan {output}.plan -o {output}`. End your reply with exactly one line:

JUBARTE_RESULT: success

when the artifact at {output} has both paragraphs rewritten and tracked by {author}; otherwise:

JUBARTE_RESULT: failed

Do not print anything after that line.

rubric.description: Both rewrites composed in one plan; one transaction; section structure preserved.
